summary: Both requirements are met. Spec 55 no longer creates tasks with hardcoded C:/tmp cwds; it uses seedTask (real temp cwd, attached to the seeded project) and an afterEach with cleanupTaskCwd then cleanupProject. Specs 80 (compact block) and 80b (desktop and 1024px boundary blocks) each seed a project with one task via helpers/board-fixture.ts, set it active, and tear it down. Only client/e2e files changed; no assertions removed or loosened. Reviewer did not run the specs. Note: the 'Terminal survives a breakpoint crossing' describe in spec 80 stays unseeded (detail-page based, out of scope).
